**To the residents of Larkspur Lofts**

I’m Jess Okafor in 5A. I’ve lived here for three years and wanted to address the drone flight on Saturday, October 31.

At about 4 p.m., I flew my new Halvard Mini 4 from the roof deck for roughly 11 minutes. I was testing it before a wedding I’m photographing in Dundee. The camera was pointed west toward the river and the Fremont Bridge the entire time, not at anyone’s windows. I’m happy to show anyone the full, unedited footage. You can knock on my door or email me at jess.okafor@mailbox.example.

I’m sorry the flight worried people. I understand how a buzzing drone hovering above the courtyard could feel unsettling if you didn’t know what it was doing. I heard that some children were frightened, and I regret that my test flight caused them distress.

I also want to say that seeing a lobby note with my unit number and a personal insult was upsetting. I’d appreciate it if concerns about me or my actions were raised with me directly rather than through notes posted in shared spaces.

The HOA rules don’t currently address drones. I won’t fly from the roof again until the board has decided whether to set a rule. I’ll ask that the topic be added to the agenda for the board meeting on November 19 at 7 p.m. in the community room.

Thank you for reading. I hope we can handle questions like this respectfully and find a clear approach that works for everyone.

Jess Okafor  
Unit 5A
